request.subject: ICON:CURIOSITY:WISHING_WELL

layers.text: Erase everything except the stone well, its roof, its posts and its bucket: remove the brown soil and the green grass under the well completely, so the well stands directly on a transparent background with nothing at all under it. Keep the grey stone well, the roof, the bucket, the small gold coin, the outline and the art style exactly the same.
